 As a Talent Acquisition Partner at StackAdapt, you'll play a pivotal role in leading full-cycle recruitment activities, with a dedicated focus on positions across Commercial functions. Your primary focus will be to attract and secure top-tier talent using diverse strategies such as inbound applicant pools, proactive sourcing, and leveraging referrals.  Functional Expertise: Solid experience driving mid-to-senior level recruitment cycles, with a strong understanding of standard hiring practices and candidate evaluation.
 Stakeholder Collaboration: Experience partnering with hiring managers to understand team needs, communicate regular updates, and guide smooth interview cycles.
 Problem Solving: Ability to troubleshoot standard recruitment roadblocks and adapt sourcing strategies to meet changing hiring priorities.
 Multi-Requisition Management: Ability to manage multiple active requisitions concurrently while maintaining candidate engagement and momentum.
 Data & Reporting: Familiarity with tracking key recruitment metrics to inform hiring teams and support continuous improvement.
 Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for moving searches forward, anticipates risks, follows through on commitments, and keeps stakeholders aligned throughout the process.
 Continuous Improvement: Looks beyond filling individual roles to identify opportunities to improve interview quality, hiring manager capability, candidate experience, and overall recruitment practices.

Tiger Analytics is an advanced analytics consulting firm. We are the trusted analytics partner for several Fortune 1000 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning and AI. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner. 
 We are looking for a Delivery Lead with 10–15 years of experience to manage multiple concurrent value streams and drive initiatives from strategy through execution. The ideal candidate will bring strong Retail/CPG industry experience, a business-oriented mindset, and expertise across Pricing, Supply Chain, Sales & Marketing, and Demand Planning & Forecasting. 
 This role requires the ability to identify bottlenecks impacting value realization, prioritize high-impact interventions, and work closely with business and analytics teams to deliver measurable outcomes.
 Key Responsibilities
 Partner with Retail/CPG business leaders to understand objectives, business drivers, and key decisions—not just document requirements.
 Lead multiple concurrent value streams and drive initiatives through end-to-end delivery and value realization.
 Structure ambiguous business problems into clear hypotheses, analyses, and decision frameworks.
 Conduct hands-on analysis to identify trends, opportunities, performance gaps, and key bottlenecks, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
 Lead executive and operational decision support through data-driven analysis, planning, and performance insights.
 Identify and prioritize high-impact interventions across Pricing, Supply Chain, Sales & Marketing, and Forecasting.
 Identify opportunities to build and enhance Decision Support Systems (DSS), analytics solutions, and data products in partnership with product, analytics, and technology teams.
 Leverage GenAI, Agentic AI, analytics, and low-code/no-code tools to rapidly prototype solutions and accelerate decision-making.
 Orchestrate cross-functional teams including data scientists, engineers, domain experts, product teams, and AI specialists.
 Communicate insights and recommendations effectively to senior stakeholders and drive alignment toward measurable business outcomes.
 Track delivery progress, business impact, risks, and dependencies across value streams.
 Continuously explore emerging AI and technology capabilities and identify opportunities to apply them to business problems. 
 10–15 years of experience in business analytics, strategy/management consulting, commercial analytics, operations, supply chain, finance, marketing/customer analytics, product management, or other decision-oriented business functions.
 Significant experience working in the Retail/CPG industry.
 Strong business-first consulting and problem-solving mindset, with experience working directly with business leaders.
 Strong understanding of retail functions such as Pricing, Supply Chain, Sales & Marketing, and Forecasting.
 Demonstrated ability to move from business question → hypothesis → analysis → insight → recommendation/action.
 Strong experience managing multiple workstreams and driving initiatives through end-to-end delivery.
 Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
 Hands-on experience with SQL, BI/visualization tools and/or Python, along with strong analytical aptitude.
 Experience identifying business opportunities, prioritizing interventions, and translating analytics into measurable outcomes.
 Interest or hands-on exposure to GenAI, AI agents, automation, or emerging technologies.
 Ability to work effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and rapidly learn and apply new technologies.
 This position offers an excellent opportunity for significant career development in a fast-growing and challenging entrepreneurial environment with a high degree of individual responsibility.

A profitable DTC pet brand doing $50M+ a year, scaling to $100M+, fully remote is looking for an experienced brand consultant, freelancer or agency to lead our brand revamp and set our brand direction as Head of Brand & Community, on a project / consultant basis! You will own how people see and feel about our two brands: the brand story and identity, and the brand moments that build awareness and goodwill, including shelter and charity partnerships, activations and events, PR and community.
 We are looking for someone who has done it before and really understands building a brand: creating brand moments and knowing how to actually make them happen, so we build our brand and brand awareness from the ground up. The ideal candidate has 7+ years in brand, communications or brand marketing at consumer brands, a track record of building awareness through cause partnerships, events and PR, and has run campaigns for a North American audience.
 The mission of this role
 Make our brands the most loved and trusted pet brands in North America, not just the most bought. You will own how people see and feel about our brands: a clear brand story and identity used everywhere, and the brand moments that build awareness and goodwill, including shelter and charity partnerships, activations and events, PR and community. Success is more people searching for us by name, more customers coming from word of mouth, more earned press, and a giving-back program customers know us for.
 Who are we?
 We're a profitable DTC pet brand selling premium stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a dog brand, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
 What is our culture like & who is a good fit?
 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
 Better Everyday : review every brand moment against its goal, and make the next one bigger, cheaper or better.
 Speed Is King : jump on cultural moments and press opportunities the same day, and launch every brand moment on schedule.
 Work Smart : use partners, agencies and AI instead of a large team. For example, use Claude to draft press pitches and partner outreach, track media mentions, turn reviews into customer stories, and build the monthly brand-health report from search, survey and press data.
 Overdeliver : bring the CEO new partnership and brand-moment ideas before being asked, and get more press and goodwill from each moment than the plan called for.
 If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. 
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.
 Outcomes (what success looks like)
 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date. 
 More people know and search for our brands : branded search volume and direct traffic, monthly vs the same month last year
 More new customers come from word of mouth and press : share of new customers who say friend, family, press or social (not an ad) in the post-purchase survey
 We earn press and attention : earned media mentions and their reach each quarter, including press from each brand moment
 Our giving-back program makes a real, visible impact : shelters partnered, pets helped, and product and dollars donated each quarter, shown on the website
 The brand looks and sounds the same everywhere : quarterly brand audit across website, packaging, ads, email and social
 Key Objectives
 Own the brand story, positioning, tone of voice and brand guidelines for both brands, and keep the two brands distinct.
 Design and run a giving-back program with shelter and rescue partners that customers know us for, and track its impact.
 Build the yearly brand-moment calendar and run each moment end to end: concept, partners, budget, website and email, social and creators, and press.
 Run pop-ups, events, sponsorships and stunts, each with its own budget and goal.
 Win earned media: pitch every brand moment, cause campaign and launch, directly or through a PR agency you manage.
 Build a super-fan community and turn customer reviews, photos and stories into brand content.
 Report brand health monthly and own the brand budget.
 Fully remote, project / consultant basis (freelancers, consultants and agencies welcome), based in Canada, the United Kingdom or Ireland
 Fluent in English
 Brand Experience: 7+ years in brand, communications or brand marketing at consumer brands is ideal; 5–6 years with strong results is also considered.
 Brand Builder: You have built awareness and goodwill for a consumer brand through causes, events and PR, not just design, ideally from an early stage.
 Brand Moments: You have planned and shipped brand moments end to end, on time and on budget, across many partners.
 Cause Marketing: You have run nonprofit or shelter partnerships that were real, measured and credible, not a logo on a page.
 PR & Storytelling: You turn a moment into a story that press and customers repeat, and you have the press wins to show for it.
 North America: You have run campaigns for a North American audience, and can run events and partners there remotely through agencies, partners and local contractors.
 Brand Taste: A sharp eye for what is on-brand, and you protect consistency across every touchpoint.
 Commercial Mindset: You tie brand work to measurable results like branded search, word of mouth and press.
 No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work.
 Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
 Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.
 Bonus points: pet industry experience.
 Accountabilities
 What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week. 
 Brand foundation and guidelines : Own the brand story, guidelines and asset library for both brands, review new pages, packaging, emails and key ads before they go live, and run a quarterly brand audit across every touchpoint.
 Cause and shelter partnerships : Choose each brand's anchor causes with the CEO, sign and manage national and local shelter and rescue partners, run adoption events and donation drives, and track and report the impact.
 Brand moments and activations : Build the yearly brand-moment calendar (National Cat Day, National Dog Day, Clear the Shelters, Giving Tuesday and our own owned moment), run each one end to end, and hand its story and assets to the growth and creator teams.
 PR and earned media : Pitch press and podcasts directly or through a PR agency you manage, win reviews, gift-guide placements and awards, keep the press kit current, and track every mention.
 Community and customer stories : Turn reviews, photos and stories into brand content, build a super-fan community with surprise-and-delight moments, and make the website show the brand properly.
 Brand reporting and budget : Report brand health monthly, own the brand budget (events, donations, PR, sponsorships), set monthly Rocks with the CEO, and write SOPs so the playbook works without one person.
 How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate
 (1) Application + Screening Interview
 (2) In-Depth Interview with the CEO
 (3) Reference Calls
 (4) Final In-Depth Interview with the CEO
 Rate Expectation
 US$7,000–10,000 per month retainer (or equivalent day rate), based on experience and expertise.

 Responsibilities

 Own end-to-end delivery for complex technical programs, defining scope, milestones, success metrics, and execution approach across multiple teams.

 Establish operating rhythm and governance (cadence, decision logs, escalation paths) to keep stakeholders aligned and unblocked.

 Demonstrated ability to lead multi-team programs through the full lifecycle: discovery, planning, execution, launch, and post-launch learning.

Hi! 👋 I'm Chris https://www.linkedin.com/in/chkrlee/, head of Product Design at Ashby.

We're looking for a versatile, intrinsically motivated designer who is excited to contribute to rethinking how modern software is designed. At Ashby, you'll be part designer, part product manager, part consultant, and part design system manager (or some combination of the 4!). We do design differently here, and if that excites you, read on.

Our unique approach is working - we're growing >100% year-over-year and have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, very low churn, and many years of runway. We're backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more! We’ll share more details once we meet.




HOW WE WORK

In my previous roles, product teams always consisted of a product manager, a designer, and ~4-5 engineers. This may sound familiar to you! The product manager briefs the designer who then designs. After designing, mocks are handed to the engineers. 

We take a more principled approach here at Ashby. If you've been designing software enough, you'll realize in actuality, design is required in varying degrees on each project. Sometimes in the past, I'd be asked to design yet another settings page, when really all that was needed was an engineer to reuse existing components and just follow some documentation I had written. Other times, I felt I should effectively be the product manager and own a project from beginning to end. In these latter cases, it made sense that I was even the one providing project updates and managing resources rather than constantly being pinged by a separate product manager.

This principled approach is now what we do here, and it is part of what has allowed Ashby to take down incumbents in multiple verticals all at once. We don't settle for the status quo—we actively resist reversion to the mean.

Currently, I report to Benji, the co-founder & CEO. Both Abhik and Benji (our founders) care deeply about design, which at first glance may seem counterintuitive given the number of full-time designers that we employ. The belief is not that design is unimportant, but rather that it should be owned by the product team collectively, not solely by a group of full-time designers who happen to have the job title. 

The design department’s job at Ashby is not to make every single design decision but to equip our entire product team to make better decisions themselves, as well as edit decisions that PMs/Engineers choose to make. That, while tackling the biggest design challenges ourselves. 



Separate from design, you may also be excited by the fact that we maintain a near seed-stage-like culture with fuzzy lines between functional roles, as much autonomy as you can handle, and a focus on IC-work with an almost-no-meeting culture. While you get the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup, you also get the agency and no-nonsense, no-red-tape culture of a seed-stage startup.




WHAT WE’RE BUILDING

Talent teams aspire to build a hiring process that identifies great candidates, moves them quickly through the interview process, and provides an excellent experience for the candidate. To accomplish this, recruiters perform thousands of daily tasks to coordinate and relay information between candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers. Teams struggle to keep up!



Scheduling a final round is an excellent example of our customers' challenges. A recruiter needs to collect availability from the candidate, identify potential interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and perform any last-minute adjustments as availability changes. They must perform this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others. 



Ashby provides talent teams with intelligent and powerful software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We put a lot of effort into designing products that are approachable to beginners but mastered and extended by power users. In many ways, spreadsheets set the bar here (and are what we often replace!).




WHY YOU SHOULD OR SHOULDN’T APPLY




YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 4+ years of product design experience in desktop SaaS.

 - Able to think from first principles instead of simply applying the “standard” UX processes.

 - Can break down complex user problems by asking questions that narrow down the solution space.

 - Enough experience that your intuition can solve many usability problems without having to rely solely on data & metrics or conducting user research.

 - Curious & resourceful enough to come up with creative solutions and de-risk them appropriately.

 - Strong skills in layout, navigation, IA, UI, and interaction design.

 - Strong visual design skills and obsession with craft & details.

 - As a bonus, you have experience at an early-stage startup or have spent time as a solo designer on a team.




YOU MAY WANT TO APPLY IF YOU’RE EXCITED ABOUT:

 - Creating leverage and impact far and above what you'd see in a typical EPD product team structure. You won’t be a cog in the wheel, the wheel is not very big!

 - Getting to work on all parts of a massive product surface area - spanning many user types, JTBDs, usability challenges, etc. Unlike in other organizations, you won’t be stuck working on one problem for many years.

 - Helping reinvent the design model for modern enterprise software—you don’t have to build wireframes, user journeys, personas, etc. What matters is solving a customer’s problem; what tools you use are up to you.

 - Covering all parts of the design process with a focus on design craft. You'll still be doing the occasional user research interview but will be focused on using heuristics & experience to improve our IA, navigation, interactions, UI patterns, and more.

 - Helping build our design system from (almost) the ground up.


CONVERSELY, YOU MAY NOT WANT TO APPLY IF:

 - You feel uncomfortable designing independently without much guidance from a PM or design management.

 - You’re uncomfortable having your decisions and process being challenged constantly by engineering & product.

 - You prefer an in-person role over remote (Ashby operates remotely).

 - You dislike written documentation.

 - You want a set structure and rhythm to your projects.
   
   - PM gives you a brief, you do wireframes, then mocks, then pass off work to engineers. Rinse and repeat.

 - You prefer a narrow job scope - interaction design only, design system only, etc.


ON A WEEKLY BASIS YOU WILL FIND YOURSELF:

 - Consulting for engineers who need help structuring layout, typography, flows, etc.

 - Digging into problems by consulting GTM, talking to customers, asking for data requests, and more in order to present confident assumptions about your proposals.

 - Using Figma to draw out your ideas and create visual artifacts for stakeholder alignment.

 - Writing specification docs (we call them specs!) that detail your design proposals. These documents are meant to get stakeholder alignment on the biggest decisions you want to make and are a core part of how we work at Ashby.

 - Taking ownership of larger product features and thinking through Jobs-To-Be-Done, navigation, information architecture, layout, interaction, etc.

 - Taking in customer feedback and using heuristics to build your own usability backlog and propose projects for engineers to take on.

 - Consolidating and refining our design system to be functional, aesthetic, and best-in-class.


INTERVIEW PROCESS

At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together and talking through decisions. Our interview process is four rounds with some casual Zoom coffee in between to get to know each other: 

 1. 30m introduction call to discuss Ashby and your experience

 2. 45m portfolio review

 3. 75m design exercise and app teardown. The exercise will be a live whiteboarding exercise where we provide a prompt and you show us how you'd break down problems and come up with solutions. 

 4. 2.5hr final round - meet the team + portfolio repeat with a founder

I'll be your main point of contact and prepare you for interviews. You’ll meet other engineers and product managers as well (with lots of time to ask them questions). If we don’t give an offer by the last round, I'll provide feedback as to why if you'd like it (I'm serious!).




BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary and equity.

 - 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable. This is one of the reasons I joined personally - not a lot of startups do this.

 - Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it.

 - Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

 - Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

 - $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

 - If you’re in the US, top-notch health insurance for you and your dependents with all premiums covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

 Job ID #32284: Primary Care Paramedic - Traditional Stream 
 Union: OPSEU Local 256 
 Job Description ID #: 2229 
 Close date: Interested applicants please submit your application online at www.hamilton.ca/city-council/jobs-city by 4:00 p.m. on November 18, 2026. 
 Vacancy type: This posting will be used to fill current vacancies 
 Internal applicants should apply with your work e-mail address . External applicants are considered only after the internal posting process has been completed. Only applicants chosen for an interview will be contacted. 
 SUMMARY OF DUTIES 
Reporting to a Supervisor, Hamilton Paramedic Service, the paramedic provides primary emergency medical care and transportation for ill and/or injured persons in the community to, from, and between treatment facilities, in specially equipped ambulance vehicles and emergency response vehicles. Paramedics also contribute to non-emergency and multi-disciplinary community care initiatives, through avenues such as public education, harm reduction, community paramedicine, palliative care, and other related programs.
 GENERAL DUTIES 
Provide primary emergency medical care for ill and/or injured persons at the emergency site by providing basic and advanced pre-hospital life support.
Provide transportation for ill and/or injured persons, to, from, and between treatment facilities, in specially equipped ambulance vehicles as directed by the dispatching Central Ambulance Communications Centre (CACC).
 Deliver thorough patient assessment and treatment in accordance to Provincial and local standards and medical directives.
Responsible for all medical interventions as deemed essential by the Base Hospital and Hamilton Paramedic Service, including: controlled drug therapy, manual defibrillation, and cardiac dysrhythmia interpretation according to Provincial Medical Directives.
Interact with members of the health care team, allied emergency care providers, the public, and patients in a professional manner.
Maintain communication with and follow the directions of all Central Ambulance Communication Centres (CACCs) encountered during operations, ensuring each CACC is kept informed of the paramedic’s status and location.
Assume a role of leadership, as required, and uphold patient advocacy.
Collaborate with medical personnel and allied emergency care providers to facilitate prompt treatment, support, and advocacy for the patients, their family and friends during the time of emergency care.
Participate in primary care, public health, public education, and community events as assigned.
Check, maintain, and stock fleet vehicles so-as to maintain the vehicle and vehicle equipment in a clean/sanitary, mechanically safe state of readiness in accordance with local and provincial standards.  Report any vehicle and/or equipment deficiencies and assist in corrective action where qualified.
Inspect, restock, and maintain ambulance stations in a clean and operational state.
Completion of all required documentation, including but not limited to Ambulance Call Reports, Incident/Occurrence Reports, Logistics Reports, Vehicle Inspection Reports, and any other report as deemed necessary by the Hamilton Paramedic Service and/or the Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care.
Participate in Continuing Education as required and participate in the training/precepting of Advanced Care and Primary Care paramedic students and other allied healthcare professionals.
Maintain all legislated requirements for employment and all certification requirements as set by the Base Hospital, the Hamilton Paramedic Service, and the MOHLTC.
Perform other duties, as assigned, which are directly related to the major responsibilities of the job.
 QUALIFICATIONS 
1. Must hold certification as a Primary Care Paramedic or higher or be eligible for certification prior to start of employment.
 2. Diploma or letter confirming good standing and indicating program completion date from an approved Ontario Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) Training Program required prior to hiring.
 3. If graduation was prior to 2003, must provide proof of completion of all mandatory Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care core programs via individual certificates or with a letter attesting to completion by an approved Ontario PCP Training Program.
 4. Current Basic Life Support (BLS) Provider certificate or CPR Healthcare Provider (HCP) certificate or Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) certificate.
 5. Hold the qualification of, or have obtained a pass standing, in an advanced emergency medical care assistant examination (AEMCA), or equivalent, as outlined in the Ambulance Act O. Reg. 257/00.
 6. If non-AEMCA certified, must have successfully completed an approved Ontario PCP Training Program and must achieve AEMCA Certification within 210 days of paramedic program completion as per Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care guidelines, unless otherwise specified by the MOHLTC (per Ambulance Act Reg. 257/00).
 7. Must possess and maintain a valid Ontario Driver's Licence that authorizes the operation and driving of an ambulance.
 8. Must meet all current requirements (including medical) of the Ambulance Act and Regulations, including the current Ambulance Service Communicable Disease Standards. As a condition of employment, you will be required to provide proof of the minimum requirements required as outlined in the Ambulance Act and Regulations.
 9. Must successfully complete any/all requirements and become fully certified by the Centre for Paramedic Education and Research (CPER) with Hamilton Health Sciences (HHS) Base Hospital Program (including, but not limited to, palliative care certification within the first 6 months of certification).
 10. Demonstrated ability to read, write, and speak English proficiently.
 11. Proven ability to demonstrate leadership and take command during emergency situations.
 12. Must be in good physical health and capable of lifting heavy weights.
 13. Proven ability to exercise sound judgement in emergency situations.
 14. You must acknowledge and agree to comply with any future vaccine policy requirements as an ongoing condition of employment at the City of Hamilton.
 15. Preference may be given to those with additional relevant education (e.g. ACLS/PALS/ITLS/NRP/PEARS certification), experience, and/or related employment (paramedic, medical transfer, and other allied health professions). General knowledge of the City of Hamilton and its geography may be considered an asset.
 THIS POSITION REQUIRES A VALID ONTARIO DRIVER’S LICENCE THAT AUTHORIZES THE APPLICANT TO DRIVE AN AMBULANCE (I.E. CLASS “F”, ETC.) AND PROOF THEREOF IS REQUIRED DURING THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS. PLEASE REFER TO THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS GUIDE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.

The employer maintains discretion regarding evaluation and selection of qualified candidates. Please refer to the Primary Care Paramedic Recruitment webpage and Traditional Stream Process and Information Guide for detailed information regarding the recruitment process. These important dates and timelines can be found at www.hamilton.ca or at the following link: https://www.hamilton.ca/city-council/jobs-city/recruitment-opportunities/primary-care-paramedic-recruitment

You must have no criminal convictions for which a pardon has not been granted at time of application. A Police Vulnerable Sector Check (upon receiving a conditional offer of employment), which is satisfactory to the City of Hamilton, will be required at your expense. An original is required.

Depending on the project, this person may contribute directly to hands-on VFX production, in-engine implementation, feedback, task breakdowns, optimization, workflow documentation, and cross-discipline collaboration.

 Responsibilities
 Create custom real-time visual effects and implement them in-engine using Unreal Engine 5, Unity, or proprietary tools.
 Build high-quality effects for gameplay, environments, cinematics, atmosphere, combat, interaction, destruction, UI/game feedback, and other project needs.
 Create all necessary textures, flipbooks, materials, meshes, simulations, and supporting assets for real-time VFX.
 Maintain clean, readable, well-structured material graphs, Niagara systems, parameters, naming conventions, and reusable effect setups.
 Use tools such as Photoshop, Substance Designer, Blender, Houdini, Maya, EmberGen, or other software as needed to support effect creation.
 Work with complex material setups, Blueprints, scripting hooks, animation events, gameplay triggers, or engine-specific implementation needs.

 Own VFX optimization fundamentals, including particle counts, overdraw, shader cost, texture memory, spawn rates, scalability settings, and platform performance constraints.

 Contribute to VFX workflow improvements, reusable templates, documentation, libraries, naming standards, or scalability rules when appropriate.
 Requirements
 5+ years of professional game industry experience as a real-time VFX Artist or similar role.
 At least one shipped game title.
 Proven end-to-end real-time VFX workflow experience, from concept and asset creation through in-engine implementation and polish.

 Interest in growing into broader leadership responsibilities over time.

 Houdini experience.
 EmberGen experience.
 Unity experience.
 Substance Designer experience.
 Experience with proprietary engines or custom VFX tools.
 Scripting or coding skills, such as C#, Python, Blueprint, or similar.
 2D animation or traditional animation experience.
 3D animation, simulation, or procedural content creation experience.
 Experience creating both stylized and realistic effects.
 Experience with foliage, atmospherics, environmental effects, weather, destruction, or ambient world VFX.

 Experience collaborating with teams across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
 Experience establishing VFX standards, templates, naming conventions, libraries, scalability rules, or pipeline documentation.

 Real-time VFX assets with strong readability, timing, shape language, and clearly understandable visual elements.

 Effects that demonstrate fundamentals such as composition, mood, color choices, timing, motion, impact, readability, and understanding of natural energies.
 Examples of effects implemented in-engine, preferably in Unreal Engine 4 or 5 / Niagara.
 Breakdowns showing your process, including textures, materials, emitters, timing, implementation, optimization, or technical setup where applicable.
 Clear explanations of what you personally created, especially for any team-created work.

 Examples that show how you balanced visual quality with performance constraints.

Gamers are rewarded for their time and money spent within the games and can redeem those rewards for gift cards. Mistplay is on a mission to be the best way to play mobile games for everyone everywhere! Download Mistplay on the Google Play Store here and follow us on Instagram, Twitter and Facebook.

🇫🇷 La description en français est ci-dessous ⬇️ 
Overview
Mistplay is the loyalty platform for mobile gamers. Players earn real rewards for playing games on Android and iOS, game studios pay us to acquire players who stay, and our LoyaltyPlay offerwalls extend that economy into other publishers' apps. A rewards economy can sometimes attract people who want the rewards without the play, and the ways they try keep changing: device farms, emulators, multi-accounting, referral abuse, account takeover, spoofed playtime and purchases, and low-quality traffic on the supply we sell to advertisers.
AI has changed the nature of that fight. Attackers now use it to generate accounts, mimic real play sessions, write convincing appeals and automate offerwall completions at a scale and speed that rule-based defences were never built for. We believe the answer is to be better at AI than they are. We're looking for a leader who will build stronger detection, prevention and mitigation, including through the use of AI: agents that triage and investigate, models that learn faster than attackers adapt, and tooling that lets a small team cover a large and shifting surface.
You will be accountable for our fraud strategy, our fraud roadmap and the metrics demonstrating ongoing and improved fraud prevention the company runs on, and you'll report on all three to the Senior Leadership Team and the board. You won't do it alone. You'll work in a tight coordination with our Fraud Analytics Manager and an Engineering Manager, who bring the analysts and engineers; together you define the roadmap, and you are the one accountable for landing it, working with Product to get it into plans and shipped.
This is a hands-on role in the sense that matters: you'll be in the data, running investigations, prototyping detection logic, shaping enforcement policy and running the response when an attack hits. It starts as a senior individual contributor position, and we expect it to grow: as the function matures there is room for this person to take on direct reports.
 
What You'll Be Doing
Own the fraud strategy and roadmap. Keep a clear, current picture of where we're exposed and what it costs, decide what we tackle this quarter and next, and turn that into a roadmap the Fraud Analytics, Engineering and Product teams commit to. Bring new features, offers and reward mechanics through an abuse review before they launch, and push back when something isn't ready.
 
Be the accountable owner of Mistplay's fraud metrics. Define how we measure loss, prevalence and false positives, make sure the numbers are trusted, and deliver regular updates on our fraud posture, strategy and progress to the Senior Leadership Team and the board.
 
Lead detection and enforcement work with the Fraud Analytics and other cross-functional teams. Set the investigation agenda, dig into live attack patterns alongside the analysts, prototype the rules and models that stop them, and hand clean specs to engineering to productionise. Own the enforcement ladder, from warnings and holds through to account and device bans, and the appeals policy behind it, so that real players aren't the collateral. You’ll also work cross-functionally with our commercial and marketing teams to ensure coordination and resolution with our clients and our marketing channels.
 
Stand up fraud on-call and incident response. Build the on-call rotation and the incident response playbooks and procedures for fraud events, with clear severity levels, escalation paths and communication to the business. When an incident happens, run it: contain the attack, coordinate analytics, engineering, support and finance, and keep leadership informed. Afterwards, own the post-incident review and report, and make sure the mitigations that prevent a repeat get prioritised and shipped.
 
Protect the quality of what we sell. Set traffic-quality standards for LoyaltyPlay and our third-party offerwall publishers, decide how we score and act on publisher-level fraud, and own the install-quality story we tell advertisers, including how we handle disputes.
 
Make the function AI-native. Bring LLM and coding agents into day-to-day fraud work, from triage and evidence gathering to first-pass investigations, with people making the final enforcement calls. Help the analytics team adopt them, and keep an eye on AI-driven abuse as a threat in its own right.
 
Own our platform and vendor choices. Decide how we use Play Integrity, App Attest and our MMP's fraud tooling, evaluate device-intelligence and bot-detection vendors against measured results, and make the call on what we buy.
 
Influence across the company. Fraud touches Commercial, Marketing, Engineering, Product, UA, Supply, Support, Finance and Legal. You'll be the person who keeps everyone clear on what good looks like and what they own, without needing formal authority over any of them.
What We're Looking For
10-12 or more years in fraud, risk, trust and safety or anti-abuse, much of it at a consumer platform, mobile ad network, MMP or rewards business. You've personally dealt with several of the threats above and can talk in detail about what worked and what didn't.
 
Comfortable and current in the data. Strong SQL, enough Python to prototype and analyse, and a track record of designing detection logic that ran in production, even if someone else deployed it.
 
Sharp analytical and critical reasoning: you can size a loss, weigh it against the cost of a control, and make a call you can defend to a CFO.
 
Experience owning a fraud or risk strategy and roadmap, and presenting it to senior leadership or a board.
 
You've run fraud or security incidents end to end, ideally having set up the on-call and incident response process yourself, and you can show how your post-incident work stopped the same thing happening twice.
 
Proven ability to get things done through teams you don't manage, and to partner well with analytics and engineering leaders who do.
 
AI-forward in practice: you use LLM and coding agents in your own work, you've applied AI to detection or investigation before, and you have a grounded view of where it helps and where a human has to decide.
 
Working familiarity with Play Integrity, App Attest or DeviceCheck, MMP fraud suites and the device-intelligence vendor landscape.
 
Strong communication and collaborative skills, including strong follow-through.
 
Nice to have: Rewarded gaming, offerwall or incentivized UA experience; Databricks or Spark; graph or link analysis; mobile client security knowledge; prior people management or a desire to grow into it.
What Mistplay Offers
Real ownership of a domain that protects revenue, player trust and advertiser relationships, and presenting fraud strategy and results directly to the Senior Leadership Team and the board.
A Fraud Analytics team and an Engineering Manager as your day-to-day partners, inside an AI forward, fast paced engineering culture 
A role designed to grow with you, including the option to build and lead a team as the function expands
Competitive compensation and benefits package.
Interview Process
A conversation about your experience, a fraud strategy case & a hands-on data exercise (AI assistants welcome), and an onsite conversation with the CTO & Fraud Analytics Manager & Fraud Engineering Manager where you walk through your case the way you would on-the-job with senior leadership.
 
🇫🇷 Description en français
Aperçu du poste
Mistplay est la plateforme de fidélisation pour les joueurs mobiles. Les joueurs gagnent de vraies récompenses en jouant à des jeux sur Android et iOS, les studios de jeux nous paient pour acquérir des joueurs engagés, et nos mur d'offres LoyaltyPlay étendent cette économie aux applications d'autres éditeurs. Une économie de récompenses peut parfois attirer des personnes qui souhaitent obtenir des récompenses sans jouer, et leurs méthodes évoluent continuellement : fermes d'appareils, émulateurs, comptes multiples, abus de parrainage, prise de contrôle de compte, falsification du temps de jeu et des achats, et trafic de faible qualité sur l'inventaire que nous vendons aux annonceurs.
L'IA a modifié la nature de cette lutte. Les fraudeurs l'utilisent désormais pour générer des comptes, imiter de vraies sessions de jeu, rédiger des appels convaincants et automatiser la réalisation d'offres à une échelle et une vitesse auxquelles les défenses basées sur des règles n'ont jamais été préparées. Nous croyons que la solution consiste à être meilleurs qu'eux en matière d'IA. Nous recherchons un leader qui saura bâtir une détection, une prévention et une atténuation plus fortes, notamment grâce à l'utilisation de l'IA : des agents qui trient et enquêtent, des modèles qui apprennent plus vite que les fraudeurs s'adaptent, et des outils permettant à une petite équipe de couvrir une surface vaste et évolutive.
Vous serez responsable de notre stratégie anti-fraude, de notre feuille de route anti-fraude et des indicateurs démontrant une prévention continue et améliorée sur lesquels l'entreprise s'appuie, et vous rendrez compte de ces trois éléments à l'équipe de direction principale et au conseil d'administration. Vous ne le ferez pas seul. Vous travaillerez en étroite coordination avec notre gestionnaire de l'analyse de la fraude et un gestionnaire de l'ingénierie, qui dirigent les analystes et les ingénieurs; ensemble, vous définirez la feuille de route, et vous serez la personne responsable de sa réalisation, en collaborant avec l'équipe Produit pour l'intégrer aux plans et la déployer.
Il s'agit d'un rôle concret au sens le plus important : vous serez dans les données, mènerez des enquêtes, prototyoerez la logique de détection, façonnerez la politique d'application des mesures et gérerez la réponse lorsqu'une attaque survient. Il s'agit au départ d'un poste de spécialiste individuel senior, et nous nous attendons à ce qu'il évolue : à mesure que la fonction mûrit, cette personne pourra prendre en charge des collaborateurs directs.
Ce que vous ferez
Détenir la stratégie et la feuille de route anti-fraude. Maintenir une vision claire et actuelle de nos vulnérabilités et de ce qu'elles coûtent, décider de nos priorités pour ce trimestre et le suivant, et transformer cela en une feuille de route envers laquelle les équipes d'Analyse de la fraude, d'Ingénierie et de Produit s'engagent. Soumettre les nouvelles fonctionnalités, offres et mécaniques de récompense à une révision des risques d'abus avant leur lancement, et repousser ce qui n'est pas prêt.
Être le responsable ultime des indicateurs de fraude de Mistplay. Définir notre manière de mesurer les pertes, la prévalence et les faux positifs, veiller à ce que les chiffres soient fiables et présenter des mises à jour régulières sur notre posture, notre stratégie et nos progrès en matière de fraude à l'équipe de direction et au conseil d'administration.
Diriger les travaux de détection et d'application avec l'équipe d'Analyse de la fraude et d'autres équipes pluridisciplinaires. Établir le programme d'enquête, analyser les schémas d'attaque en direct aux côtés des analystes, prototyper les règles et modèles qui les stoppent, et transmettre des spécifications claires à l'ingénierie pour la mise en production. Détenir l'échelle des sanctions, des avertissements et des blocages temporaires jusqu'aux bannissements de comptes et d'appareils, ainsi que la politique de contestation sous-jacente, afin de ne pas léser les véritables joueurs. Vous travaillerez également de manière transversale avec nos équipes commerciales et marketing pour assurer la coordination et la résolution avec nos clients et nos canaux marketing.
Mettre en place la garde anti-fraude et la réponse aux incidents. Mettre sur pied le roulement de garde et les guides de réponse aux incidents pour les événements de fraude, avec des niveaux de gravité clairs, des parcours d'escalade et une communication adaptée à l'entreprise. Lorsqu'un incident survient, gériez-le : contenez l'attaque, coordonnez l'analyse, l'ingénierie, le support et les finances, et tenez la direction informée. Ensuite, prenez en charge l'examen et le rapport post-incident, et veillez à ce que les mesures d'atténuation empêchant une récidive soient priorisées et déployées.
Protéger la qualité de ce que nous vendons. Définir les normes de qualité du trafic pour LoyaltyPlay et nos éditeurs tiers de murs d'offres, décider de la manière d'évaluer et d'agir sur la fraude au niveau de l'éditeur, et détenir l'argumentaire de qualité d'installation présenté aux annonceurs, y compris la gestion des litiges.
Rendre la fonction axée sur l'IA. Intégrer les LLM et les agents de codage dans le travail quotidien sur la fraude, du triage et de la collecte de preuves aux enquêtes de premier niveau, des humains prenant les décisions finales d'application. Aider l'équipe d'analyse à les adopter et surveiller les abus générés par l'IA en tant que menace à part entière.

 Portless helps fast-growing direct-to-consumer brands ship orders from our fulfillment centers in China straight to their customers in North America, the UK and beyond. Brands no longer have to import and warehouse inventory in every market, which frees up cash and cuts costs. 
 We run the whole chain: fulfillment, freight, customs clearance and last-mile delivery, tied together by our own software and AI. Our merchants are mid-market brands in apparel, beauty, electronics and home goods. 
 We are venture-backed and on track to double revenue in 2026. Our team works across North America, China and beyond. 
 You will own Portless's books end to end: the monthly close across our entities in North America and Asia, merchant billing and collections, cash, and our first external audit. You will lead our accounting team, most of whom are based in China, and build the processes and controls that let us keep growing fast. 
 This is a hands-on role. You will be in the reconciliations yourself before you hand them off, and you will have real ownership from day one.

 Month-end close. Own the close calendar across all entities, including consolidation, intercompany and FX, and get it done faster each month.

 AR and collections. Keep AR reconciled to the bank and payment processors, set our bad-debt reserve policy, and run collections with our billing team.

 Tax and compliance. Coordinate outside advisors on Canadian, US and Chinese filings, sales tax and VAT, and transfer pricing. 
 Systems and controls. Tighten our stack (QuickBooks Online, Stripe, Bill.com, Ramp), document how things get done, and decide when we need an ERP. 
 Team. Lead and develop the accounting team, give every process a clear owner, and work closely with our data and engineering teams on billing data.

 Outcome

 Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;

 Strong written English (C1+).

Wiza is the most accurate B2B prospecting platform on the market, with 850M+ contacts, verified in real time, trusted by 500,000+ GTM professionals. We're profitable, growing fast, and among the highest rated data tools on G2.
 This is a remote role based in North America. For candidates based in Toronto, you will have optional access to our downtown office space.
 Why we're hiring this role
 Our Director of Marketing will help to develop our strategy, and drive our next phase of growth.
 Wiza has taken a major leap in the past two years - thousands of people sign up for Wiza every week, our data wins head-to-head accuracy tests against every major competitor, and we're embedded in the products GTM teams already use. We are cash positive and profitable, which means you get to build for compounding growth rather than for a runway.
 Three revenue motions are growing at once — self-serve/ PLG revenue, sales-led annual contracts, and a fast-growing API business where partners deploy Wiza data inside their own products. You will develop a team that effectively helps us accelerate each of these massive opportunities.
 What you'll own
 Full-funnel demand. Everything from awareness to closed revenue: organic, paid, content, lifecycle, and product-led. You own the number — pipeline sourced and influenced — not just activity. You'll direct our external partners on paid and decide what we bring in-house.
 Positioning and the story we tell. Wiza serves a range of use cases from prospecting and list building, CRM enrichment and upkeep, to powering external workflows via our API. You'll sharpen the narrative for each one and make sure it lands consistently across channels.
 Product marketing and launch. We ship fast, and there's meaningful capability landing every month. Your team will help keep our customers and market educated to the fast developing capabilities of the platform.
 Product-led growth. Our self-serve funnel is one of our biggest assets — a continuous, high-volume flow of exactly the users we want. Working with Product, your team will influence paths that move a free user to paid, an individual to a team, and a curious developer to API spend. We think some of the fastest wins in the business are here.
 New markets. We're horizontal by nature, and we're actively expanding into segments where great contact data is a genuine unlock — financial services, enterprise sales orgs, and industries the incumbents have served poorly. You'll help choose which ones we go after and build the programs that reach them.
 Measurement and operating cadence. Partner with RevOps — who are strong, AI-native, and already instrumented — to close the loop on source attribution, funnel conversion by segment, cost per opportunity, and what signups actually become. You'll bring that to the GTM leadership table monthly and set the agenda with it.
 Marketing at Wiza. We want you to build a high-performing team with exactly the mix of talent that you want to work with, and compliment your skills the best. You will have an open headcount on day 1 to help you tackle the many opportunities we have for growth.
 Who will be great in this role
 Someone who wants to own a function outright help steer the future of Wiza
 Someone who gets genuinely nerdy about conversion metrics, GTM tech, and how modern buyers actually find software
 Someone who is comfortable being both a strategist, and a tactician when required 
 Someone who remembers that they are working with humans, and cares about being a positive member of Wiza's daily culture

 7+ years in B2B marketing, with real depth in demand generation and ownership of a full funnel

 Leadership and a strong instinct on what skill set you want to bring in with your first hire

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 
 La communauté à laquelle vous vous joindrez 
 Vous deviendrez un membre clé de l’équipe de planification du soutien à la communauté des Opérations mondiales. Cette équipe pilote le processus de planification de la feuille de route, de bout en bout, pour le soutien à la communauté d’Airbnb. Elle veille à ce que les initiatives et les programmes soient priorisés en fonction de notre stratégie globale et de notre engagement à offrir une expérience client exceptionnelle. Nous sommes une équipe mondiale experte en planification stratégique, en gestion des parties prenantes, en collaboration interfonctionnelle et en efficacité organisationnelle.
 La différence que vous ferez 
 À titre de partenaire principal de planification, Contenu, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la réussite et la satisfaction de notre clientèle grâce à une gestion des relations rigoureuse et à une collaboration stratégique. Vous soutiendrez un ou plusieurs domaines de produits et serez la personne-ressource principale des gestionnaires de contenu, des rédacteurs et rédactrices ainsi que des stratèges de ces domaines. Vous assurerez la planification et la coordination de bout en bout de chaque lancement qui a une incidence sur le contenu du soutien à la communauté. Vous veillerez à ce que la communication soit claire, que les objectifs soient harmonisés et que le contenu soit livré à temps et avec un haut niveau de qualité au moment du lancement. Vous repérerez de façon proactive les occasions d’ajouter de la valeur tout en vous attaquant aux difficultés potentielles, avec toujours en tête d’obtenir des résultats mesurables pour notre clientèle et pour l’entreprise.
 Votre capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec les partenaires du contenu, du produit, de l’ingénierie, du marketing et des affaires juridiques, alliée à votre esprit stratégique et à votre rigueur d’exécution, contribuera au bon déroulement des lancements ainsi qu’à la réussite de notre clientèle et de l’organisation.
 Une journée type 
 Établir un dialogue proactif avec les partenaires et les parties prenantes interfonctionnels : suivis réguliers, communication des échéanciers de planification et des jalons à venir, séances de rétroaction. Le but est de bâtir la confiance et de s’assurer de l’harmonisation avec leurs buts et objectifs.
 Déterminer à l’avance toutes les personnes responsables de chaque lancement : le rédacteur ou la rédactrice et le ou la stratège du contenu touché; les personnes chargées d’approuver le contenu pour le marketing, les affaires juridiques et l’expertise technique; les partenaires de localisation; et les partenaires interfonctionnels, comme la taxonomie, la formation, le centre de ressources, Biztech et les autres gestionnaires de projet dont les travaux sont liés.
 Élaborer le calendrier du contenu et le communiquer à toutes les personnes qui demandent du contenu et à celles qui l’approuvent. Pour ce faire, recueillir les dates d’indisponibilité des personnes chargées d’approuver et prévoir du temps pour les audits de contenu, la rédaction, la vérification de l’exactitude technique, la révision par le marketing, la révision juridique et la localisation, ainsi qu’une marge pour les imprévus.
 Planifier et animer la série de réunions de chaque lancement : la séance de collecte d’information sur le lancement avec les équipes du produit, de l’ingénierie et de la préparation au lancement; les séances d’audit de contenu; une réunion préalable au lancement avec le marketing; une réunion hebdomadaire récurrente sur l’état du lancement avec l’équipe de contenu et les experts techniques; et, le jour du lancement, une réunion « Mission Control » et un canal Slack.
 Collaborer avec les stratèges lors des audits de contenu pour repérer tout le contenu touché, en hiérarchiser les répercussions (P1 : jour du lancement; P2 : suivis à court terme; P3 : tous les autres éléments), s’assurer qu’un billet est ouvert pour chaque article touché et signaler le contenu lié à l’interface utilisateur ainsi que les exigences de localisation.
 Préparer et envoyer chaque semaine un compte rendu de l’état d’avancement aux gestionnaires de contenu et aux personnes responsables du contenu, incluant la liste des articles touchés et leur état P1/P2/P3, afin que les risques (calendrier des audits, approbations en retard, changements de date de lancement) soient visibles rapidement.
 Anticiper les risques et les problèmes, et élaborer de façon proactive des stratégies d’atténuation (aller au-delà du simple suivi de l’état d’avancement et mener les problèmes jusqu’à leur résolution). Maintenir un processus pour repérer les demandes de contenu tardives et les signaler comme étant « à risque ».
 Envoyer régulièrement des rappels aux personnes ayant des responsabilités liées au lancement et, lorsque les personnes chargées d’approuver ne répondent pas en mode asynchrone, planifier des rencontres d’approbation en direct avec le marketing, l’ingénierie, les affaires juridiques et d’autres intervenants.
 Préparer des communications interfonctionnelles à l’intention des équipes partenaires touchées par notre travail, comme la localisation, Biztech, la gestion des connaissances et la formation.
 Coordonner en temps réel la mise en ligne le jour du lancement, une fois le feu vert donné par l’équipe de préparation au lancement, afin que l’équipe de contenu sache qu’elle peut publier en toute sécurité.
 Participer aux réunions de lancement, aux séances de coordination en temps réel et aux séances du centre de contact organisées par d’autres équipes afin d’être la voix de l’équipe de contenu, de faire le point, de répondre aux questions et de tenir l’équipe de contenu informée des problèmes émergents.
 Épargner aux rédacteurs et rédactrices les questions logistiques, obtenir les renseignements et les approbations manquants et lever les obstacles, afin de leur permettre de se consacrer au contenu.
 Préparer à l’intention de la direction une bilan de lancement qui décrit ce qui a été publié et le rendement du contenu, et tenir un registre du contenu publié pour alimenter les rapports, mettre en valeur les réussites et documenter les leçons apprises.
 Suivre l’état des dossiers transmis à un palier supérieur après le lancement et en rendre compte.
 Favoriser l’amélioration continue et la simplification des processus de planification du contenu, et mettre en place des mécanismes de rétroaction qui permettent de communiquer les suites données aux partenaires et aux parties prenantes.
 Votre expertise 
 Au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans des postes de planification stratégique, de gestion de programmes ou d’opérations d’affaires, avec des réussites démontrées.
 Expérience avérée du pilotage de processus de planification interfonctionnelle ou de gestion de portefeuille, avec une exposition à la haute direction.
 Compétences exceptionnelles en communication (orale, écrite et présentations) auprès de tous les niveaux d’une organisation.
 Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse, ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension de la mise en œuvre de systèmes et de la gestion du changement.
 Maîtrise des outils de collaboration à distance et de gestion de projet, comme Asana, Jira et Airtable.
 Esprit stratégique et sens de l’organisation, et capacité de travailler en collaboration avec différentes équipes.
 Connaissance pratique du cycle de vie et des méthodologies de développement de produits logiciels. Une expérience concrète de la méthodologie Agile est un atout.
 Capacité éprouvée à désamorcer les situations tendues et à résoudre les conflits de façon professionnelle et empathique.
 Capacité de gérer simultanément plusieurs lancements et priorités concurrentes, tout en veillant à ce que les livrables soient remis à temps et dans le respect de la portée du projet.
 Aisance à composer avec des priorités changeantes et capacité de proposer des solutions dans un environnement dynamique, ambigu et au rythme soutenu.
 Expérience de la planification ou de la coordination de lancements de contenu, de gestion des connaissances ou de produits.
 Votre emplacement : 
 En raison de la nature de ce poste, le candidat retenu devra être basé au Canada pour pouvoir effectuer son travail. Actuellement, les employés peuvent être situés dans : la Colombie-Britannique, l'Ontario, le Québec, l'Alberta ou le Saskatchewan. Cette liste est continuellement mise à jour, veuillez vérifier avec nous si les provinces dans lesquelles vous vivez figurent sur la liste. Si votre poste est employé par une autre entité Airbnb, votre recruteur vous informera des provinces dans lesquelles vous êtes éligible pour travailler.
 Notre engagement envers l’inclusion et l’appartenance : 
 Airbnb s'engage à travailler avec le vivier de talents le plus large possible. Nous pensons que la diversité des idées favorise l’innovation et l’engagement, et nous permet d’attirer des personnes créatives et de développer les meilleurs produits, services et solutions. Toutes les personnes qualifiées sont encouragées à postuler.
